text: Acknowledging page. I am stepping in as Incident Commander for this incident. Opening incident bridge.
Declaring **P1 - CRITICAL INCIDENT (INC-402)**: Checkout failures affecting all US regions. Roles: @sarah.dev (Tech Lead), @marcus.ops (Comms), @elena.db (DBA).
Checking logs on checkout-api pods. We are seeing `TimeoutError: Connection pool exhausted. Available connections: 0, Waiting requests: 142`.
PostgreSQL instance CPU is only 18% and total active backend connections is only 100 out of max 1500. The bottleneck is definitely client-side connection pooling inside checkout-api.
Status page updated: 'We are investigating an issue preventing some users from completing checkout.' Internal stakeholders notified.
Found it. PR #842 merged 40 minutes ago in release v2.4.1 set `max_connections: 10` per pod. Under our 25 RPS load, 10 pods * 10 = 100 connections is saturating immediately.
Decision: Rollback immediately to v2.4.0. Do not attempt hotfix in place.
Rollback deployment triggered: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/checkout-api -n production`.
All 10 pods running v2.4.0. Error rate dropping sharply: currently 1.2% and falling.
All telemetry metrics nominal. Error rate < 0.05% for 5 minutes. Declaring INC-402 RESOLVED. Postmortem review scheduled for tomorrow at 10:00 AM.
